raised.raise: Lens switches ripple row by row, and refresh restyles rows inside the grid.
One committed company ink at full saturation across board and charts.
Tier gutters and score columns snap to one armature with tabular numerals.
Lens chips own the single saturated action color.
A hovered row doubles its score rule weight.
Tier colors form a fixed legend that no lens recolors.
